title: Protocol for efficient solid-phase synthesis of peptides containing 1-hydroxypyridine-2-one (1,2-HOPO)
author: Al Shaer, de la Torre, et al.

steps.title: Resin loading and swelling
steps.instruction: Weigh 143 mg (0.1 mmol) Fmoc‑Rink‑amide‑AM‑PS‑resin and place it in a 5 mL polypropylene syringe fitted with a 20 µm filter; put the syringe on the vacuum manifold, apply gentle suction, wash the resin with DMF (1 mL, 1 min) three times, drain, add 3 mL DMF and let the resin swell for 15 min.

steps.title: Fmoc deprotection
steps.instruction: Prepare a 20 % (v/v) piperidine solution in DMF (no need to make fresh each time). Add 1 mL of this solution to the swollen resin, stir 1 min, drain, add another 1 mL, stir 7 min, then filter and wash the resin with DMF (3 × 1 mL).

steps.title: Amino acid coupling cycle
steps.instruction: For each coupling: weigh the required Fmoc‑AA‑OH (0.3 mmol, 3 eq. to resin) together with 43 mg OxymaPure in a separate glass vial; dissolve the mixture in the minimum DMF needed to cover the resin (≈600 µL for 143 mg resin). Add DIC (47 µL, 0.3 mmol) to the solution, let activate for 2 min, then transfer the slurry to the resin, ensuring complete coverage; let react 40–60 min with occasional stirring, confirm completion with a ninhydrin test, drain, and wash with DMF (1 mL, 30 s) three times. Repeat the deprotection (step 2) and coupling (this step) for every amino acid in the sequence.

steps.title: N‑terminal acetylation
steps.instruction: After the final Fmoc removal, add DIEA (345 µL, 20 mmol) followed by AcCl (95 µL, 10 mmol) to the resin, shake 30 min, then drain and wash with DMF (3 × 1 mL).

steps.title: Synthesize Bzl‑protected HOPO
steps.instruction: In a round‑bottom flask, combine 1,2‑HOPO‑4‑COOH (155 mg, 1 mmol) and K₂CO₃ (268 mg, 2 mmol), add 10 mL MeOH, and place the flask in an oil bath. Stir and add benzyl bromide (143 µL, 1.2 mmol) dropwise over 1 min. Attach a condenser and reflux at 65–70 °C for 16 h. Remove MeOH under reduced pressure, dissolve the residue in 5 mL H₂O (add a few drops of 1 M NaOH if needed), acidify with 6 M HCl to pH 2 to precipitate the product, filter, wash the solid with ice‑cold water, and dry under vacuum (≈70 % yield).

steps.title: Mtt deprotection and amine liberation
steps.instruction: Place the peptide resin (from step 4) in the syringe on the manifold and wash with DCM (3 × 1 mL). Prepare a deprotection solution of TFA:TIS:DCM (3:5:92 v/v) containing 300 µL TFA, 500 µL TIS and 9.2 mL DCM. Add 2 mL of this solution to the resin, shake 15 min, filter, and repeat the treatment once more. Wash the resin with DCM (3 × 3 mL, 30 s each). Then wash with 5 % DIEA in DCM (3 × 1 mL) to liberate the free Lys amine, followed by DCM (3 × 1 mL) and DMF (2 × 1 mL). The resin is now ready for HOPO coupling.

steps.title: HOPO coupling to lysine
steps.instruction: For each Lys to be derivatized, prepare either (a) 24 mg (0.15 mmol) unprotected 1,2‑HOPO‑4‑COOH or (b) 37 mg (0.15 mmol) Bzl‑protected 1,2‑HOPO‑4‑COOH in 600 µL DMF. Transfer the HOPO solution to the resin and add DIC (24 µL, 0.15 mmol per Lys). Shake for 90 min, then drain and wash with DMF (3 × 1 mL).

steps.title: Optional second HOPO coupling
steps.instruction: If desired, repeat the HOPO coupling using reduced equivalents of HOPO and DIC to increase overall loading; this step may be omitted to save the expensive unprotected HOPO.

steps.title: Remove ester oligomers (unprotected HOPO)
steps.instruction: When unprotected HOPO was used, treat the resin with 1 mL of 20 % piperidine in DMF for 10 min, then wash the resin with DMF (3 × 1 mL) and finally with DCM (3 × 1 mL).

steps.title: Peptide cleavage with mixture A
steps.instruction: Wash the peptide resin with MeOH, dry under gentle suction, weigh, and transfer to a capped Falcon tube. Add cleavage mixture A (TFA:TIS:H₂O = 95:2.5:2.5, 1 mL per 100 mg resin) and shake 70 min. Add ice‑cold diethyl ether (5 mL per 1 mL cleavage mixture), shake, centrifuge, decant, and repeat the ether wash two more times. Dry the residue under reduced pressure, dissolve in 3 mL water, filter off resin beads, wash the beads twice with 1 mL water each, combine all filtrates and lyophilize to obtain the crude peptide.

steps.title: Peptide cleavage with mixture B
steps.instruction: Perform the same initial steps as for mixture A, but use cleavage mixture B (TFA:TFMSA:TIS = 8:3:1, 1 mL per 100 mg resin). After shaking 70 min, add water (5 mL per 1 mL cleavage mixture), then wash the aqueous layer with diethyl ether (5 mL) three times. Filter off resin beads and lyophilize the aqueous filtrate to obtain the crude peptide.

steps.title: Purification and characterization
steps.instruction: Purify each crude peptide by reversed‑phase semi‑preparative HPLC, collect pure fractions, lyophilize and store at 4 °C. Determine purity by analytical HPLC at 220 nm (peak‑area comparison) and confirm identity by LC‑MS. Calculate yield from the mass of the lyophilized peptide relative to the theoretical mass (see Table 1 for reported values).
